summary: Implemented closeout directive compilation for S02T04. Added closeoutDirectiveDataByRegistryId and compileCloseoutAgentDirectiveBundle so terminal closeout snapshots produce static-registry directive data for user summaries, Git checkpoint-or-reason state, handoff, container descendant closeout, verification, and next workflow directives. Updated the static registry so work cancel participates in closeout/checkpoint selection and terminal closeout commands can emit workflow_next directives. Added tests for successful finish, cancellation, forced duplicate, and no-change paths.
